settings.title: Aroma & use
settings.body: Cool eucalyptic lift over a sweet, resinous base. Bruise two or three pods with the flat of a knife and drop them in whole for rice and braises; grind the seed only for desserts, and only just before you need it.

settings.title: Grade, honestly
settings.body: The millimetre figure is a sieve size, not a quality score. You are paying for appearance and a thicker husk. If these are going into a grinder, buy the smaller grade from the same lot — same cure, same hills, less money.

settings.title: Storage
settings.body: Keep the pods whole and the tin shut, away from the hob and out of the light. Don't decant into a clear jar, however good it looks. Cold is unnecessary; dark is not.
